summary: Softronic AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology and management consulting services in Sweden. The company offers Modern Work M365, a cloud-based suite of tools and services that improves productivity, collaboration, workflows, and security for businesses and organizations; Dynamics 365, an end-to-end platform that streamlines business processes, automates workflows, and provides businesses with data-driven decision support; AI, data analytics, and automation; hybrid IT operations; cybersecurity; cloud transformation; and secure system development. It also provides SaaS solutions, including Softronic Member Solution, a modern membership system; Atlassian as a service; Softronic Pay, a payment hub for Swish payments; CM1, an AML system for countering money laundering; MRM Reskontra, a ledger system for member organizations; MMS, a cloud-based membership system; and Charity, a tailor-made system for fundraising activities. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
